description: KSP Mod Admin aOS (KMA²): mod manager for Kerbal Space Program. Installs, updates and removes mods from archives, URLs (forum, CurseForge, SpaceDock, GitHub) or drag and drop, lets you pick which parts of a mod to install, detects file conflicts between mods. Abandoned upstream since 2019.
notes: KSP Mod Admin is abandoned (last release 2019-04-27); for current KSP, gesu/CKAN is maintained.
Leave its own update check off (Options tab, 'Check for new version on startup') and update with
'scoop update KSP-Mod-Admin': its updater replaces the files in the app folder behind Scoop's back.
Its settings and the list of KSP installs live in %ProgramData%\KSPModAdmin\KSPModAdmin\KSPModAdmin_aOS.cfg,
each KSP install's mod list in KSPModAdmin_aOS.cfg in the game folder, downloads in %USERPROFILE%\Downloads.
'scoop uninstall -p' deletes none of them. Only its log, KSPMA.log, is kept in
Mod changes in a game under %ProgramFiles(x86)% (a Steam library in the default place) need admin rights.
